name: LoRA Fine-Tuning of DINO
definition: A method to adapt frozen DINO features to the geometric objectives of NeRF by applying Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to the attention layers of the Vision Transformer backbone, making only the low-rank matrices trainable.
summary: LoRA Fine-Tuning of DINO adapts frozen DINOv2 features to NeRF geometry by training only low-rank matrices, enabling efficient few-shot 3D reconstruction.
